152887.overview: Krazy Kong is based on the arcade game Donkey Kong where you have to move from the bottom of the screen to the top to rescue a Princess held by a giant ape. To move up the screen you have to climb ladders and move along platforms while avoiding or jumping barrels that roll down the platforms and ladders. There are also stars that move from the bottom of the screen and move upwards and if you touch a barrel or a star then you lose one of three lives. Later levels see moving platforms as well as spikes that shouldn't be landed on.

476169.overview: Kongs Revenge is a Donkey Kong variant. Like in the original arcade game, the player has to save a maiden from a vicious monkey. To reach the maiden at the top of the screen, the player has to climb ladders and jump between platforms. A ladder is automatically climbed when the player walks onto it, and it is not possible to go back down (although some levels have lifts to go down). To avoid climbing a ladder, the player has to jump past it and then the ladder is destroyed. The player has to watch out for barrels dropped by Kong, as well as fireballs. Barrels can be jumped past, while fireballs cannot be avoided. Ladders are destroyed when hit by a fireball, which might make a level unfinishable. The player has five lives and is given a score when all are lost. After a game is over, it's possible to restart from the current level without going back to the first.
